scoring_justification: Dielectric constant absolute values depend on DFT convergence parameters; monotonicity and digitized reference comparison with wide tolerance are used. Full DFT recomputation infeasible in checker.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference epsilon_33 values at equilibrium and +/-2% strain digitized from Fig.1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from the figure using coordinates; approximate values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values reflect the published trend; no fabricated synthetic holdout.

outputs.description: Dynamic dielectric constant component ε33 along c-axis of hexagonal La2O3 as a function of lattice constant under hydrostatic strain. The checker verifies that epsilon_33 is non-decreasing as lattice_constant increases and performs a few result-level comparisons within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The absolute values depend on numerical parameters (k‑point grid, cutoff), so monotonicity is the primary scoring criterion. The agent must write the required JSON schema.
